title: Workspace suggestion stage event
description: One stage transition of a run, streamed while it happens so the page can say where the run has got to. Stages are ids, not sentences: the application owns every user-facing word, so renaming a stage here can never change what a customer reads.

stage.description: Where the run is. An id the application does not know renders nothing rather than leaking.

attempt.description: Which attempt this stage belongs to. The run is bounded at three.
